_comment: Baseline of accepted LaunchOps deep_red_flags fingerprints. CI gate (scripts/ci/verify_launchops_deep_red_flags_baseline.sh) compares .launchops/deep_red_flags.json against this file and fails on any fingerprint not listed here. To accept a new flag, run the gate with UPDATE_BASELINE=1 and commit this file alongside the human review evidence it represents. Fingerprint = sha256(json.dumps({severity, flag_type, sorted(files)}, sort_keys=True))[:16].
